content:
samir: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for Cypress Dataworks (private VPC) — proposed maintenance window Wed 2026-03-25 02:00-03:00 UTC. Requesting ops/product ack and a quick signoff on the backout criteria.

jess: 👍 product + compliance noted. Need a one-paragraph blurb for release notes and confirmation no PHI touchpoints.

maria: Ops ack — no DB schema changes, no tenant migrations on this rollout. Confirm cert rotation is not scheduled same night?

samir: Correct — cert rotation is on 2026-03-28. Also pin runtime to rwd-infer-3.2.1-quant for the customer. Canary at 3% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then full.

alina: I'll run metrics dashboard and manual regression checks during canary. I'll be on pager.

evan: I'm oncall that night, available for immediate rollback. What are the thresholds for an automatic rollback?

samir: Rollback triggers (proposed):
- error rate spike > 1.5% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 450ms above baseline for 5m
- any customer-reported functional regression (blocking)
If any trigger fires, we rollback to rwd-infer-3.1.8-stable and divert traffic back to dedicated control plane.

jess: Sounds reasonable. Add a note to customer comms: we'll notify them 24h before and again 30m before window starts.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled deploy created:
```
/deploy --customer cypress-dataworks --env dedicated --version rwd-infer-3.2.1-quant \
  --canary 3 --canary-duration 15m --next-step 25%:10m --window 2026-03-25T02:00Z-2026-03-25T03:00Z
```

maria: Runbook snippet (ops):
```
1) Verify pre-deploy health checks: control-plane ok, model servers healthy
2) Kick canary via deploybot and confirm logs/kvcache warmup
3) Watch telemetry: errors, p95, token-throughput, memory spikes
4) If rollback: /deploy-rollback --to rwd-infer-3.1.8-stable and open incident channel
```

alina: I'll prepare a short smoke test prompt set and pin it to dashboard alerts. If any test fails 2/3 times we abort.

evan: Ops + SRE agreed SLA for this customer is 99.9% p99 latency. We'll keep an eye on p99 but only use p95 as automatic gating.

samir: Thanks. Can we get final thumbs from product + oncall? @jess @evan @alina

jess: :thumbsup: product signoff given. I'll draft the customer note and post in #customer-success to loop them in.

evan: :ok_hand: oncall ack. I'll stay until the quiet window clears.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary started at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z — 3% traffic routed. Monitoring hooks active.

alina: :eyes: Canary metrics look clean for first 8m, error rate 0.1%, p95 within baseline. Proceeding to 25% at T+15m if stable.

samir: Perfect. Leaving rollback instructions pinned in runbook. Will post final reminder 24h and 30m prior.

jess: Thanks team. :shipit:
